morphology.pattern_note: se- 在这里表示共同、同一；直接接 perjuangan，词干不变。perjuangan 进一步来自 per- + juang + -an。

senses.zh_definition: 为共同目标一起奋斗的；共同参与同一事业或斗争的。
senses.en_definition: United in pursuing or struggling for a common cause.
senses.nuances: 常修饰 kawan、rakan、teman 或 saudara，强调共同目标和奋斗经历。既可用于社会运动，也可用于求学或工作中的相互勉励；并非所有朋友或同事都适合这样称呼。释义依据：[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=seperjuangan)。

collocations.en: a fellow campaigner or companion in a shared struggle

collocations.zh: 志同道合、共同奋斗的同道
collocations.en: a comrade in a common cause

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Beliau merakamkan penghargaan kepada rakan seperjuangan yang turut mempertahankan hak pekerja.
dual_scenarios.zh: 他向一同维护劳工权益的奋斗伙伴表达了谢意。
dual_scenarios.en: He expressed his appreciation to fellow campaigners who had worked alongside him to defend workers' rights.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita kan geng seperjuangan, susah senang kita hadap sama-sama lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita ialah rakan seperjuangan; kita menghadapi kesusahan dan kesenangan bersama-sama.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱们可是一起奋斗的伙伴，有苦有甜都一起扛啦。
dual_scenarios.en: We're in this together, remember? We'll face the ups and downs together.
spoken_features: kan 用于提醒对方双方共有的认识。
geng 是朋友间对伙伴群体的口语称呼。
hadap 是 menghadapi 的口语简化；lah 加强亲近、鼓励的语气。

messages.speaker: Farah (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah penat buat tesis ni. Nasib baik ada kau, kawan seperjuangan aku.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah penat menyiapkan tesis ini. Mujurlah kamu ada sebagai kawan seperjuangan saya.
messages.zh: 这论文写得我好累，还好有你这个一起奋战的伙伴。
messages.en: I'm exhausted from working on this thesis. I'm glad I've got you going through it with me.

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)
messages.ms_spoken: Sikit je lagi. Esok kita sambung kat perpustakaan, ya?
messages.ms_standard: Hanya tinggal sedikit lagi. Esok kita menyambung kerja di perpustakaan, ya?
messages.zh: 就差一点了。明天咱们去图书馆接着写，好吗？
messages.en: We're nearly there. Let's carry on at the library tomorrow, okay?

etymology.historical_story: Seperjuangan is built within Malay from se-, expressing shared identity, and perjuangan, a struggle or sustained effort. Its cultural force comes from belonging to the same cause: a companion is remembered for enduring difficulties alongside others. This makes the expression useful in public commemorations as well as personal encouragement between people pursuing demanding goals. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=seperjuangan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 se- 的“同”和 perjuangan 的“奋斗”：同一场奋斗里的人，就是 seperjuangan。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 带有团结、敬重和情感认同，适合致谢、纪念和鼓励。正式称呼 saudara seperjuangan 时，saudara 表示同道，不必有亲属关系。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于确有共同目标或经历的人最自然。在政治活动中可能暗示阵营认同；一般职场若只想表达同事关系，rakan sekerja 更准确。
